label: Synthesized Indigenous spatial sovereignty with Pueblo gynocratic cosmology
description: Parallel to Deloria’s spatial metaphysics, Gunn Allen recovered gynocratic Pueblo-Sioux philosophies that center feminine creative power and ecological balance.
dialecticalTension: Genders Indigenous metaphysics beyond patriarchal Western spirituality.

label: Helped catalyze Indigenous feminist reclamation of oral philosophy
description: Gunn Allen’s centering of Indigenous women’s cosmology deeply resonated with Lee Maracle’s Stó:lō feminist theory in I Am Woman.
dialecticalTension: Forwards transnational North American Indigenous feminist philosophy.
